en-US.description: AXIS Camera Station Device Compatibility Tool helps you to verify if a third-party network video product is compatible with AXIS Camera Station 5 and above.
en-US.longDescription:
AXIS Camera Station Device Compatibility Tool helps you to verify if a third-party network video product is compatible with AXIS Camera Station 5 and above.

It is easier to run a test with this tool instead of installing and running a trial version of AXIS Camera Station to check if it works with your devices. It also provides more information regarding the device.

When a new version is available, the tool will be automatically updated when online. If the tool is offline, please always check and download the latest version from here.
en-US.name: AXIS Camera Station Device Compatibility Tool
